name: Arr Apps
author: Chronicle Contributors
description: A reference plugin. Asks Radarr, Sonarr, Lidarr and Readarr which film, show, artist or author a file or title really is, so Chronicle can identify it by id instead of guessing from its name. It works on its own: you need only the address and API key of each application you run, and nothing else installed. Read-only, so Chronicle never changes anything in those applications. Radarr and Sonarr answers are used when Kodi scrapes a film or show; Lidarr and Readarr answers are used when Chronicle identifies a music artist or album and a book or its author.
fixMatchHint: This plugin has no Fix Match. It never takes part in choosing a match by hand: it only tells Chronicle which film or show Radarr or Sonarr says a file is, so there is nothing to paste.
